_comment: The Isle: Legacy (Windows-native / winproc). SteamCMD app 412680 -beta public, installed to the server ROOT (SteamCMD in daemon TEMP so force_install_dir is honored; run twice to clear the self-update). Launches the REAL UE4 server binary directly (TheIsle/Binaries/Win64/TheIsleServer-Win64-Shipping.exe) — NOT the 0.3MB root launcher, which spawns a detached child we can't track. -stdout makes UE write its log to stdout so the console + 'done' matcher work. The install also runs UE4PrereqSetup (VC++ redist) which the server needs on a fresh host. Game config: TheIsle\Saved\Config\WindowsServer\Game.ini (Files tab). 'done' matcher is a best guess. Ports 7777-7779 UDP.
name: The Isle: Legacy (Windows)
author: test@feathers.local
description: The Isle (Legacy/public branch) dedicated server for Windows-native winproc nodes. Installs via SteamCMD app 412680 (public branch) into the server root, installs UE4 prerequisites, and launches the Shipping server binary directly.

config.startup: {"done":["Match State Changed from WaitingToStart to InProgress"]}

installation.script:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$dir = (Get-Location).Path
$sc = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('feathers-steamcmd-' + $env:P_SERVER_UUID)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $sc | Out-Null
$zip = Join-Path $sc 'steamcmd.zip'
Write-Output 'Downloading SteamCMD...'
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd.zip' -OutFile $zip
Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $sc -Force
$steam = Join-Path $sc 'steamcmd.exe'
Write-Output 'Bootstrapping SteamCMD (self-update)...'
& $steam +quit
Write-Output 'Installing The Isle: Legacy (app 412680, branch public)...'
& $steam +force_install_dir $dir +login anonymous +app_update 412680 -beta public validate +quit
$prereq = Join-Path $dir 'Engine\Extras\Redist\en-us\UE4PrereqSetup_x64.exe'
if (Test-Path $prereq) {
  Write-Output 'Installing UE4 prerequisites (VC++ redistributables)...'
  $eap = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
  & $prereq /quiet /norestart
  $ErrorActionPreference = $eap
}
$ship = Join-Path $dir 'TheIsle\Binaries\Win64\TheIsleServer-Win64-Shipping.exe'
if (Test-Path $ship) { Write-Output 'OK: Shipping server exe present.' } else { Write-Output 'WARNING: Shipping exe NOT found.' }
Write-Output 'Install complete.'

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map path under /Game/TheIsle/Maps/ (e.g. Landscape3/Isle_V3, Thenyaw_Island, DV_TestLevel).
